cases.mission: Read case.json and audit each service against the policy. Derive whether the configuration is consistent, which services are affected, and the mismatch counts by category. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: config_consistent, affected_services, replica_mismatches, timeout_mismatches, logging_mismatches. Derive every value from case.json yourself.

Read case.json and reconcile every ledger charge with its evidence amount. Derive the ledger total, evidence total, signed difference between them, and the affected entry. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: ledger_total, evidence_total, reconciliation_delta, mismatched_entry. Derive every value from case.json yourself.

Read case.json and compare each actual service setting with its corresponding requirement. Derive whether the configuration is consistent, which services are affected, and the mismatch counts by category. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: config_consistent, affected_services, region_mismatches, retention_mismatches. Derive every value from case.json yourself.

Read case.json and reconcile invoice amounts against payments by invoice. Derive the invoice total, payment total, remaining balance, and the invoice with a short payment. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: invoice_total, payment_total, unpaid_balance, short_paid_invoice. Derive every value from case.json yourself.
